text:
sara (product): quick thread to align on tenant-aware fallback routing for enterprise customers. sales asks: per-tenant routing policy, pin to Dedicated or fall back to hosted with rate limits, and a clear SLA handoff. need sequencing and owners.

anya (customer-success): customers want deterministic p99 during peak and a documented fallback behavior. they want an opt-in flag to fall back to hosted instead of failing requests.

tom (eng-runtime): constraints: routing needs tenant tier + fallback chain. plan: policy store + cache, routing adapter, metrics & tracing. estimate ~4 weeks for a small squad.

nina (eng-infra): to guarantee isolation we need reserved node pools per tenant-class or strict cgroups. Dedicated+fallback requires tagging across LB and runtime. also need a quota controller to prevent fallback storms. reserve pool -> 3 days after budget approval.

paul (security): concerns: fallback to hosted may violate data residency and key policies. fallback must be opt-in for regulated tenants; add a "no-fallback" compliance tag. audit events for fallback required.

sara (product): propose minimal launch criteria: policy config UI/CLI, runtime emits fallback audit events, p99 for pinned Dedicated path <=200ms under pilot load, quota controller prevents >5x unexpected hosted traffic. ok?

tom (eng-runtime): agreed. p99 depends on model/seq len. we'll tag traces: route.plan and route.decision. add fallback_reason in logs.

anya (customer-success): can we surface fallback_reason in tenant dashboard and TTL the entries?

nina (eng-infra): yes, but retention costs. propose 30d pilot retention.

paul (security): add requirement: fallback_event must include audit-id + tenant_id + route_hash; disallow fallback if tenant has compliance tag.

sara (product): sequencing (owners): 1) policy model + admin API (sara + tom) 2) infra labels & reserved pool + quota controller (nina) 3) runtime adapter + tracing/audit hooks (tom + paul) 4) pilot with 5 tenants + dashboard (anya + sara). Gate 3 behind 2?

tom (eng-runtime): we can default fallback disabled until infra signals readiness. need flags: routing.enable_fallback=false and routing.max_fallback_rate_per_tenant=0.

nina (eng-infra): opening reservation + quota tickets. need finance signoff.

paul (security): drafting compliance matrix and audit schema. will sync with legal.

ops-bot: feature-flag created: tenant_fallback_v1 (disabled). will toggle when @sara says go.

anya (customer-success): include rollback plan: automatic cutover to "fail closed" for affected tenants if fallback causes billing anomalies.

sara (product): good. acceptance test: simulated failure should either (a) block fallback and return 503 for pinned tenants or (b) allow controlled rate-limited fallback. default: fail_closed for regulated tenants, rate_limited_fallback for others.

tom (eng-runtime): will break runtime work into 3 tickets by EOD tomorrow.

nina (eng-infra): will set alerts: fallback-rate >1% and billing anomaly on unexpected egress.

paul (security): ensure hosted fallback path honors tenant encryption keys where required. adding to checklist.

sara (product): thanks team. I'll assemble the launch checklist and propose pilot dates. If objections to sequence or owners, flag here.
